subject.title: [Bug]: Native Talk button triggers OpenAI Realtime WebRTC call and fails with 500 when Realtime is not configured

question: Should Control UI browser Talk start from implicit OpenAI realtime credential availability, or only after an explicit Gateway readiness/preflight says a realtime provider is usable for this session?
rationale: Current docs and provider code intentionally allow API-key/OAuth/Codex fallback, while the report expects a local/non-Realtime Talk setup not to start OpenAI Realtime; either choice changes user-facing setup semantics and possibly upgrade behavior.

options.title: Gate on Gateway readiness
options.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless talk.catalog/readiness reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

options.title: Keep implicit credential activation
options.body: Treat configured OpenAI/Codex realtime auth as sufficient and narrow follow-up work to clearer diagnostics for provider/API failures.

options.title: Require explicit realtime config
options.body: Only show or start browser Talk when talk.realtime is explicitly configured, accepting any compatibility or migration impact for existing users.

recommendation.title: Gate on Gateway readiness
recommendation.body: Disable or block browser Talk before microphone startup unless talk.catalog/readiness reports a usable realtime provider, while preserving the chosen credential policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent current-main signal for the OpenAI Realtime auth/docs policy that defines this product boundary.
